answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by auditing correlated clusters at a rate that rises with their size: identities sharing on-chain stake paths form one cluster, and the protocol samples a tenth of the cluster each epoch, demanding fresh graded work from each sampled head. A hollow shell adds nothing, but the tenth fake triggers an extra audit, the hundredth ten, and the thousandth a hundred — each audit a full graded answer the farm must write. Like a river widening as tributaries join, the work owed grows with every head, and a willow bends only so far before the cluster bond is slashed.
